notes:
- Publish (rig): you can now rig against REFERENCED models. Publish imports every loaded reference, removes their namespaces (horse_model:OBJ becomes OBJ) and fixes the ...Deformed shape names (same fix as Clean Rig Asset) before exporting rigRoot to output/rig.
- Your work file keeps its references: Publish saves it first, does the cleanup only for the export, then reopens the saved work file.
- Unloaded references are skipped and listed in the Published popup, along with any nodes Maya had to rename because two models used the same name (body -> body1).
- Clean Rig Asset is still in the menu for doing it by hand.
